about: C083 per-unit attachment data, read by tools/build-unit-models.py. Every body below is a character of the KayKit Adventurers pack (CC0 1.0); they share ONE humanoid skeleton ('Rig': hips, spine, chest, head, upperarm/lowerarm/hand/handslot.l|r, upperleg/lowerleg/foot/toes.l|r), so one animation library fits all of them and a unit is a body mesh plus the attachments listed under 'keep'. Static meshes of a body (weapons on the handslot bones, shields, helmet, hat, cape) that are not listed are dropped.

mounted.about: A mounted unit is a rider (body + attachments as above, scaled to 'riderHeight') parented to the 'saddle' joint of the generated horse rig (build-unit-models.py builds the horse: rigid boxes on a 9-joint skeleton with the six contract clips). Per clip the rider's upper body follows 'clips' and its legs and hips hold the Sit_Chair_Idle pose, so he sits the horse whatever he does with his arms.
